newsitem.title: USA: Temple-Inland sets merger exchange rate.
newsitem.headline: Temple-Inland sets merger exchange rate.

text.p: Temple-Inland Inc said Tuesday that based on preliminary calculations, it has established an exchage rate of 0.5037 for its acquistion of California Financial Holding Co.

Based on the exchange rate, the merger agreement, and the results of the elections made by the stockholders of Califirnia Financial, all undesignated shares will receive Temple-Inland common stock in the transaction.

In addition, some Califonia Financial stockholders who asked for cash will receive Temple-Inland stock as a result of the merger's random selection allocation procedure, which will affect owners of about 160,000 Califonia Financial shares.
The transaction is scheduled to close on June 27.
The exchange rate is based on an average price of $59.5625 for Temple-Inland stock, the company said.
Temple-Inland is a manufacturer of paper, corrugated packaging and building products, with financial services operations in mortgage and consumer banking.
